comparison.objective: Serve clean ice into a bowl from the covered clean-source bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Open the bin, manipulate a scoop through loose cubes, and transfer a cube while avoiding the fish-source bin.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires settled clean ice delivered by the scoop with lid-opening history and no contamination of the cube, scoop, or bowl.
comparison.reason: This is hygienic bulk-material transfer, not axial tool alignment followed by impact fracture and loose metal-fragment containment. Shared tool use and object transfer are only generic primitives.
